description: Create a platform that assigns the smallest available nonnegative ID to each uploaded digit-string video. Support removing a video, watching an inclusive minute range, recording likes and dislikes, and retrieving engagement counts. Example 1: upload "123" receives ID 0; watching minutes 0 through 5 returns "123" and increments views. Example 2: after removing ID 0, the next upload reuses ID 0. Constraints: videos are digit strings, and video IDs are reused after removal.
intuition: Video metadata is keyed by ID, while a min-heap tracks freed IDs so uploads reuse the smallest one.

brute_force.approach: Scan all IDs to find the smallest free one and scan all video records for each query.

optimal.approach: Use a dictionary for active videos and counters, plus a min-heap of reusable IDs and a monotonic next ID.

edge_cases: Operations on a missing video leave state unchanged and return the specified sentinel.
The watched end minute is clamped to the last available character.
